arabic text: CHADAREIN SAR PE NAHI SATH ALAMDAR(A.S.) NAHI
english translation text: THEY HAVE NO VEILS, NOR IS THEIR FLAG BEARER ABBAS WITH THEM

arabic text: DESH BEGANA YEHAN KOI MADADGAR NAHI
english translation text: THEY DON’T KNOW ANYONE IN THIS LAND, NOR HAVE ANYONE TO HELP THEM

arabic text: SHAMION (L.A.) SHARM KARO DOOR HATO PARDA KAO\nZEHRA SANI (S.A.) HAI KABHI AYIE YEH BAZAR NAHIN
english translation text: O’ YOU PEOPLE OF SHAAM, HAVE SOME SHAME AND LOOK AWAY,\nDID THE DAUGHTER OF FATIMA (S.A.) EVER COME TO THE BAZAAR IN SUCH A WAY?

arabic text: AAI SHIMAR (L.A.) ZULM NA KAR RO KEY YEH FIZZA NE KAHA\nTAZIANE KE KABIL AABID E BEEMAR (A.S.) NAHI
english translation text: FIZZA CRIED AND TOLD SHIMR TO STOP TORTURING THE PRISONERS,\nIMAM SAJJAD (A.S.) IS UNWELL AND NOT ABLE TO BEAR THE PAIN OF LASHING

arabic text: AAI MUSLMANO HUMEIN CHAND RIDAEN DEDO\nMANGTA IN KE SIVA KUTCH BHI YEH BEEMAR (A.S.) NAHI
english translation text: OH MUSLIMS! GIVE THE LADIES THEIR VEILS,\nTHIS IS ALL THAT IMAM SAJJAD (A.S.) IS ASKING FOR

arabic text: CHADEREIN GAR NAHI DETE TO BATAO MUJHKO\nKYA NABI ZADIAN (S.A.) YEH PURSE KI HAQDAR NAHI
english translation text: O’ PEOPLE, WHY DON’T YOU WANT TO GIVE THE VEILS TO THE WOMEN OF THE HOLY HOUSEHOLD?\nIS IT NOT THEIR RIGHT TO MOURN FOR THEIR LOVED ONES?
